title: A failed lane-lint comment post makes `merge --lane-lint` FAIL, not print a note and exit 0
why: The incident pattern "PASS, then the post failed" is in `merge --lane-lint`, not `merge --review-record` (which already posts nothing on main).
note: Todo. merge/merge.py about line 3303 prints PASS; if the lane-lint comment post then fails, it only prints a note and exits 0. Fix: a failed post is FAILED there too, red case first. Past rulings not checked; lane review-record-readback is not doing it (PR #3235 stays as handed in).
